title: 0.2.12 OTA uninstall repair
summary: This update fixes the updater so Windows uninstall files generated by Setup are preserved across OTA updates. It also prevents source-only folders from being copied into the installed runtime directory when the updater falls back to a GitHub source ZIP.
highlights: OTA now preserves unins000.exe, unins000.dat and unins000.msg, so Windows Settings can keep uninstalling Insta360_HW normally.
Source-ZIP fallback no longer leaves development-only root files such as HWAgent_Setup.iss, .gitignore, launcher, frontend, tests or docs inside C:\Program Files\Insta360\HWAgent.
The platform page still only supports removing Cadence integration; full uninstall remains owned by Windows Settings or Insta360_HW_Setup.exe.
A regression test now runs the real Sync-HwAgentTree path to prevent this uninstall breakage from returning.
compatibility: For machines already missing unins000.exe, rerun Insta360_HW_Setup.exe once to repair the Windows uninstall entry. Future OTA updates will preserve the repaired uninstaller files.
